name: @bankofai/mcp-server-tron

tools.name: get_wallet_address
tools.description: Get the address of the configured wallet. Use this to verify which wallet is active.

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description: List all available wallets. Returns wallet IDs, types, and addresses. Use select_wallet to switch between them.

tools.name: select_wallet
tools.description: Switch the active wallet at runtime. Use list_wallets to see available wallet IDs. Only available in Encrypted Storage mode.

walletId.description: The wallet ID to switch to

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: Sign an arbitrary message using the configured wallet.

tools.name: get_chain_info
tools.description: Get information about a TRON network: current block number and RPC endpoint

network.description: Network name (mainnet, nile, shasta). Defaults to mainnet.

tools.name: get_supported_networks
tools.description: Get a list of all supported TRON networks

tools.name: get_chain_parameters
tools.description: Get current chain parameters including Energy and Bandwidth unit prices. Returns structured fee information similar to gas price queries.

tools.name: convert_address
tools.description: Convert addresses between Hex and Base58 formats

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get block details by block number or hash

blockIdentifier.description: Block number (as string) or block hash

tools.name: get_latest_block
tools.description: Get the latest block from the network

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the TRX balance for an address

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get the TRC20 token balance for an address

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by transaction hash

tools.name: get_transaction_info
tools.description: Get transaction info (receipt/confirmation status, energy usage, logs).

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call read-only functions on a smart contract.

args.description: Function arguments (supports arrays and objects for complex types)

abi.description: Optional contract ABI array. If not provided, will fetch from chain. Use for contracts with incomplete on-chain ABI.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Get raw contract metadata from the chain, including ABI (if verified) and bytecode.

tools.name: get_contract_info
tools.description: Get high-level information about a contract: ABI, readable function signatures, and raw metadata.

tools.name: fetch_contract_abi
tools.description: Fetch contract ABI from the chain (for verified contracts). Returns the ABI entry array.

tools.name: multicall
tools.description: Execute multiple read-only functions in a single batch call.

args.description: Function arguments (supports arrays and objects for complex types)

allowFailure.description: Whether to allow this specific call to fail
Whether to allow individual calls to fail. Defaults to true.

tools.name: write_contract
tools.description: Execute state-changing functions on a smart contract. Requires configured wallet.

args.description: Function arguments (supports arrays and objects for complex types)

abi.description: Optional contract ABI array. If not provided, will fetch from chain. Use for contracts with incomplete on-chain ABI.

tools.name: deploy_contract
tools.description: Deploy a smart contract to the TRON network using ABI and Bytecode.

tools.name: estimate_energy
tools.description: Estimate energy consumption for a smart contract call (simulation).

ownerAddress.description: Caller address for simulation. Defaults to configured wallet.

tools.name: update_contract_setting
tools.description: Update a contract's consume_user_resource_percent (user pay ratio). Requires the contract creator's wallet.

tools.name: update_energy_limit
tools.description: Update a contract's originEnergyLimit (max energy the contract creator will pay per execution). Requires the contract creator's wallet.

originEnergyLimit.description: New originEnergyLimit value (energy units, must be > 0)

tools.name: clear_abi
tools.description: Clear the on-chain ABI metadata of a contract (ClearABIContract). Requires the contract creator's wallet.

contractAddress.description: The contract address whose ABI will be cleared

tools.name: transfer_trx
tools.description: Transfer TRX to an address.

tools.name: transfer_trc20
tools.description: Transfer TRC20 tokens to an address.

amount.description: Amount to send (raw amount with decimals)

tools.name: freeze_balance_v2
tools.description: Freeze TRX to get resources (Stake 2.0).

amount.description: Amount to freeze in Sun (1 TRX = 1,000,000 Sun)

resource.description: Resource type to get. Defaults to BANDWIDTH.

tools.name: unfreeze_balance_v2
tools.description: Unfreeze TRX to release resources (Stake 2.0).

amount.description: Amount to unfreeze in Sun (1 TRX = 1,000,000 Sun)

resource.description: Resource type to release. Defaults to BANDWIDTH.

tools.name: withdraw_expire_unfreeze
tools.description: Withdraw expired unfrozen balance (Stake 2.0). Call this after the unfreezing period to return TRX to available balance.

tools.name: cancel_all_unfreeze_v2
tools.description: Cancel unstakings, all unstaked funds still in the waiting period will be re-staked, all unstaked funds that exceeded the 14-day waiting period will be automatically withdrawn to the owner’s account.

tools.name: get_available_unfreeze_count
tools.description: Get remaining available unstake (unfreeze) operations for an address in Stake 2.0.

tools.name: get_can_withdraw_unfreeze_amount
tools.description: Get the withdrawable unstaked TRX amount for an address at a given timestamp in Stake 2.0.

timestampMs.description: Optional query timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to current time.

tools.name: delegate_resource
tools.description: Delegate staked resources (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY) from the configured wallet to another address.

receiverAddress.description: The address that will receive the delegated resources

amount.description: Amount of resources to delegate in Sun (1 TRX = 1,000,000 Sun)

resource.description: Resource type to delegate (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY)

lock.description: Whether the delegation is locked (non-revocable within the lock period). Defaults to false.

lockPeriod.description: Lock period in blocks when lock is true. Ignored if lock is false. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: undelegate_resource
tools.description: Revoke previously delegated staked resources (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY) from a receiver address back to the configured wallet.

receiverAddress.description: The address from which delegated resources will be revoked

amount.description: Amount of resources to revoke in Sun (1 TRX = 1,000,000 Sun)

resource.description: Resource type to revoke (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY)

tools.name: get_can_delegated_max_size
tools.description: Get the maximum amount of TRX (in Sun) that an address can currently delegate as resources (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY) under Stake 2.0.

resource.description: Resource type to query (BANDWIDTH or ENERGY)

tools.name: get_delegated_resource_v2
tools.description: Get delegated resource details (bandwidth and energy) between two addresses under Stake 2.0.

tools.name: get_delegated_resource_account_index_v2
tools.description: Get delegated resource account index for an address under Stake 2.0 (who delegated to this address and who this address delegated to).

annotations.title: Get Delegated Resource Account Index V2

tools.name: get_block_by_num
tools.description: Query block by block height. Returns block header and transaction list.

tools.name: get_block_by_id
tools.description: Query block by block ID (hash). Returns block header and transaction list.

tools.name: get_block_by_latest_num
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent N blocks, starting from the latest solidified block in descending order of height.

num.description: Number of latest blocks to retrieve (1-100)

tools.name: get_block_by_limit_next
tools.description: Retrieve a list of block objects within the specified block height range [startNum, endNum).

tools.name: get_now_block
tools.description: Get the current latest block information from the network.

tools.name: get_transaction_by_id
tools.description: Query transaction status and content by transaction hash.

tools.name: get_transaction_info_by_id
tools.description: Query transaction receipt including energy usage, fee, logs, and confirmation status by transaction hash.

tools.name: get_transaction_info_by_block_num
tools.description: Get TransactionInfo (receipts) for all transactions in a specific block height.

annotations.title: Get Transaction Info By Block Num

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Query historical energy unit price on the TRON network.

tools.name: get_bandwidth_prices
tools.description: Query historical bandwidth unit price on the TRON network.

tools.name: get_burn_trx
tools.description: Query the total amount of TRX burned from on-chain transaction fees since No. 54 Committee Proposal took effect.

tools.name: get_approved_list
tools.description: Query the list of accounts that have signed a given transaction. Pass the full transaction JSON object.

transaction.description: The full signed transaction as a JSON string

tools.name: get_block_balance
tools.description: Get all balance change operations in a block. Requires block hash and block number. Note: requires the node to enable historical balance query.

tools.name: broadcast_transaction
tools.description: Broadcast a signed transaction to the TRON network. Accepts the full signed transaction JSON object.

transaction.description: The full signed transaction as a JSON string

tools.name: broadcast_hex
tools.description: Broadcast a signed, protocol buffer-encoded transaction hex string to the TRON network.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create an unsigned TRX transfer transaction. The recipient account will be auto-activated if it does not exist. Returns an unsigned transaction object that must be signed before broadcasting.

amount.description: Transfer amount in SUN (1 TRX = 1,000,000 SUN)

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List all connected node addresses on the TRON network. Returns an array of node IP:port strings.

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current TRON node, including version, config, peers, and machine info.

tools.name: get_pending_transactions
tools.description: Get the list of transaction IDs currently in the pending pool (mempool).

tools.name: get_transaction_from_pending
tools.description: Get the details of a specific transaction from the pending pool by its transaction ID.

txId.description: The transaction ID (hash) to look up in the pending pool

tools.name: get_pending_size
tools.description: Get the number of transactions currently in the pending pool (mempool).

tools.name: get_events_by_transaction_id
tools.description: Get all events emitted by a specific transaction.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID (hash) to query events for

onlyConfirmed.description: Only return confirmed events. Defaults to unset (both).

tools.name: get_events_by_contract_address
tools.description: Get recent events emitted by a specific contract address.

tools.name: get_events_by_block_number
tools.description: Get events emitted in a specific block. Supports pagination via limit and fingerprint. Preferred over get_events_of_latest_block when you need precise block targeting or full event retrieval.

blockNumber.description: The block number to query events for

tools.name: get_events_of_latest_block
tools.description: Get events from the most recent block that contains events (skips empty blocks). Results may be limited by the API default page size and subject to event indexing lag. For precise control, use get_events_by_block_number with a specific block number and limit/fingerprint pagination.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get full account information including balance, resources, permissions, frozen balance, and votes.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Get account TRX balance at a specific block height.

tools.name: generate_account
tools.description: Generate a new TRON account offline (keypair generation). Returns privateKey, publicKey, and address. No network interaction needed.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Validate a TRON address and detect its format (Base58 or Hex).

tools.name: get_account_net
tools.description: Get bandwidth (net) resource information for an account.

tools.name: get_account_resource
tools.description: Get account resource details including energy, bandwidth, frozen balance, and delegation info.

tools.name: get_delegated_resource
tools.description: Query the amount of resources delegated from one account to another (Stake 2.0).

tools.name: get_delegated_resource_index
tools.description: Query the resource delegation index for an account: who delegated to this account, and who this account delegated to.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Activate a new account on the TRON network. Costs bandwidth from the configured wallet. The target address must be generated beforehand.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update the name of the configured wallet's account. Can only be set once.

tools.name: account_permission_update
tools.description: Update account permissions for multi-signature configuration. Set owner, active, and optional witness permissions.

operations.description: Hex string of allowed operations bitmask

tools.name: list_witnesses
tools.description: Get the full list of all Super Representatives (SR / witnesses) on the network.

tools.name: get_paginated_witnesses
tools.description: Get a paginated list of current active Super Representatives.

tools.name: get_next_maintenance_time
tools.description: Get the timestamp of the next network maintenance window.

tools.name: get_reward
tools.description: Query the current unclaimed voting reward for an address.

address.description: The address to query rewards for

tools.name: get_brokerage
tools.description: Query the brokerage ratio (dividend percentage) of a Super Representative. The brokerage value is the percentage that the SR keeps; the rest is distributed to voters.

tools.name: create_witness
tools.description: Apply to become a Super Representative (SR). Requires the configured wallet and burns 9999 TRX as application fee.

url.description: The official website URL of the SR candidate

tools.name: update_witness
tools.description: Update the SR node website URL for the configured wallet (must already be an SR).

url.description: The new official website URL for the SR

tools.name: vote_witness
tools.description: Vote for Super Representatives using TRON Power (obtained by freezing TRX). Each frozen TRX = 1 vote.

votes.description: List of SR addresses and vote counts

tools.name: withdraw_balance
tools.description: Withdraw accumulated voting rewards to the configured wallet's available balance.

tools.name: update_brokerage
tools.description: Update the SR brokerage ratio (dividend ratio). Only callable by an SR. Value is the percentage the SR keeps (0-100); the remainder goes to voters.

brokerage.description: Brokerage percentage kept by the SR (0-100). E.g. 20 means SR keeps 20%.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List all network governance proposals.

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Get details of a specific governance proposal by its ID.

tools.name: create_proposal
tools.description: Create a new network governance proposal (SR only). Provide a map of chain parameter IDs to proposed values.

parameters.description: Map of chain parameter key IDs (as string numbers) to proposed values. E.g. { '6': 100 } to propose changing parameter #6 to 100.

tools.name: approve_proposal
tools.description: Vote to approve or disapprove a governance proposal (SR only).

proposalId.description: The proposal ID to vote on

approve.description: true to approve, false to disapprove

tools.name: delete_proposal
tools.description: Delete a governance proposal (SR only, only the proposal creator can delete it).

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive account information from TronGrid indexed data, including TRX balance, TRC20 balances, frozen resources, and votes. Data comes from the TronGrid indexer and may have slight delays compared to on-chain state.

tools.name: get_account_transactions
tools.description: Get transaction history for an account from TronGrid indexed data. Returns all transaction types (TRX transfers, contract calls, etc.). Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint. Default 20 results, max 200 per page.

tools.name: get_account_trc20_transactions
tools.description: Get TRC20 token transfer history for an account from TronGrid indexed data. Returns token transfer details including token info (name, symbol, decimals) and human-readable values. Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint. Default 20 results, max 200 per page.

contractAddress.description: Filter by specific TRC20 token contract address

tools.name: get_account_internal_transactions
tools.description: Get internal transactions (triggered by smart contract execution) for an account from TronGrid indexed data. Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint. Default 20, max 200.

tools.name: get_account_trc20_balances
tools.description: Get all TRC20 token balances for an account from TronGrid indexed data. Returns only token contract addresses and raw balances — does NOT include token metadata (name, symbol, decimals). Use get_token_balance for detailed info on a specific token.

tools.name: get_contract_transactions
tools.description: Get transaction history for a smart contract from TronGrid indexed data. Unlike get_account_transactions, this aggregates transactions BY contract. Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint. Default 20 results, max 200 per page.

tools.name: get_contract_internal_transactions
tools.description: Get internal transactions (triggered by smart contract execution) for a contract address from TronGrid indexed data. Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint. Default 20, max 200.

tools.name: get_trc20_token_holders
tools.description: Get token holder list for a TRC20 contract from TronGrid indexed data. Returns holder addresses and their balances. Supports pagination via limit + fingerprint.

address.description: TRC20 token contract address (base58 T-address or hex 41-prefixed)
